svg.title: F26-8 Fibre fault diagnosis: end face, wavelength pair, OTDR from both ends
svg.text: 2 Loss at 1550 nm clearly above 1310 nm
locate with OTDR: E4 0.45 dB (1550 nm)
3 OTDR step above 0.3 dB from both ends
4 Step up seen from one end only
5 Loss normal but no link at the switch
OLTS shows crossed pair; replace the
cord or cassette to the design method
broken fibre: find the end reflection
on the OTDR, splice or replace
F26-8 Fibre fault diagnosis: end face, wavelength pair, OTDR from both ends
1.20 km OS2 link B2-MDF to CAMPUS-CORE · splice limit 0.3 dB, connector 0.75 dB · bend E4: 0.45 dB at 1550 nm against 0.12 dB at 1310 nm · gainer E3: -0.06 / +0.18 dB,
• A loss that is larger at 1550 nm than at 1310 nm is a bend; E4 fell from 0.45 dB to 0.04 dB at 1550 nm after the fibre was re-routed in the splice tray.
• A splice is judged on the average of both OTDR directions: E3 reads -0.06 dB from end A and +0.18 dB from end B, average 0.06 dB, below the 0.3 dB limit.
• The link total from the trace, 1.42 dB at 1550 nm, equals the OLTS result; after the bend repair it is 1.01 dB.
